guardrail: delta mAP >= -0.01; report paired interval, do not infer from means alone
window_policy: independent reset, shared weights, oldest-to-newest, includes current token
temporal_features: spatial mean only; actual encoder T retained
training_augmentation: inherited RQ2 RandomResizedCrop/Flip; not static .npy training
residual_gate: input-conditioned sigmoid, bias=-2 (nonzero gate output); correction=C*g*tanh(raw)
residual_initialization: output weight and bias zero; no second zero multiplicative gate
motion: mean(phi(projected difference)-phi(0)); nonlinear before pooling; no physical-speed claim
precision: FP32 train/val/test, autocast and TF32 disabled
test_gate: all declared arms x all three seeds complete before any final test scoring
baseline_input: Approved selected H7 weights plus original sealed metadata; not H7 resume
